_comment: ColleagueAI commercial product record, one per sellable agent: config/agents/<slug>.json. Copy this file, fill every field, run `node scripts/release/validate-product.mjs <slug>`. It holds only what no other file holds: price and package identity live in config/products.json and config/pricing.json, the factsheet text in public/agents.html (window.PRODUCT_FACTS) and scripts/generate-agent-pages.mjs (RUNTIME), the first-sale scope in config/launch-scope.json. Evidence fields name where the evidence is kept; never write an approval, signature or test result that does not exist. Schema: docs/commercial-framework/README.md.
exclusions: <what it does not do / is not included>

microsoft.capacity: <Copilot Studio capacity and how it is billed>

permissions: <security roles and what they can read/write>
tenant.humanReview: <which outputs need a named reviewer before they count>

knownLimitations: <path#section of the install guide's limitations table>

ip.instrument: <instrument and schedule that cover the works>
ip.studentWork: <none | which works, and the signed licence/assignment that covers them>

tenantEvidence: <where the tenant test logs are kept>

sale._sale_comment: goDecision / earlyAccess, once written by the founder: {approvedBy, date, reference, release: "<exact version>", expiresAt?: ISO date, revokedAt?: ISO date}. Version-specific; lib/availability.js fails closed on anything missing, other-version, expired or revoked.
